subject: Request: SummitAI promotional credits + invoice offset guidance
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Priyanka Sharma <priyanka@summitai.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Trial extension & promotional credit request for SummitAI (DL-2026-0817)

Hi Priyanka —

Thanks again for the demo last week. SummitAI is ready to pilot, and they asked if we can (1) apply $25k of trial credits to their initial invoice, and (2) extend their trial window by 30 days to accommodate an integration sprint.

Short ask: can we confirm accounting treatment and whether Finance needs a credit memo + invoice offset, or if a proforma credit memo suffices for your procurement process? I’ve attached the trial request worksheet with proposed amounts and dates.

Next steps we propose:
- You confirm procurement details / billing contact
- We issue a promo approval form internally and route to Finance for credit memo creation if needed

If it helps, CC the person who signs on purchase orders and we’ll start the paperwork.

Thanks —
Connor
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0186

Attachments: summitai_trial_request.xlsx

Connor —

Thanks, this looks reasonable. Procurement prefers a formal credit memo that can be applied to the first invoice. PO team also needs the dollar amount listed as a separate line item on the invoice before we can sign.

I’ve looped in David (CFO) — David, can you confirm this approach? If you approve, procurement will need the credit memo and a proforma invoice to complete the PO.

Best,
Priyanka
Head of Product, SummitAI
priyanka@summitai.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: connor.obrien@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: SummitAI credit request — accounting posture needed

Folks — forwarding SummitAI's ask. They want $25k in trial credits applied to first invoice + 30-day extension. Procurement requires a formal credit memo + proforma invoice.

Questions for Finance:
- Is a proforma credit memo acceptable, or do we need to create a posted credit memo against an issued invoice?
- GL mapping: where should this live for revenue recognition and promo expense? Marcus, can you confirm the GLA and whether this is contra-revenue or marketing promotion expense?
- Any approvals required beyond $25k threshold? (Connor says this is a strategic pilot but not yet in contract stage.)

I attached the internal promo approval form draft — please edit and return.

Thanks,
Marissa
Director, Sales Operations

Attachments: promo_approval_form.pdf
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Cc: connor.obrien@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:35:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: SummitAI credit request — accounting posture needed

On Tue, Nov 30, 2026 at 11:20 AM Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Folks — forwarding SummitAI's ask. They want $25k in trial credits applied to first invoice + 30-day extension.

Quick summary from Finance perspective:
- $25k should be handled as a credit memo applied to the first invoice (procurement asked specifically for an applied credit).
- Accounting treatment: book as a sales promotion contra-revenue (GLA: 7200-PROMO) to preserve gross revenue numbers for recognition; we should not post as marketing expense.
- Journal entry approach: create a proforma credit memo for procurement/PO, then when the first invoice posts, issue a posted credit memo to offset invoice line(s).
- Approval: credits > $20k require manager-level signoff (Neha) and Finance Ops (Mina) verification.

Action items for Sales Ops / AE:
1) Complete the promo_approval_form.pdf (Marissa) with reason and customer success plan.
2) Connor: confirm the exact invoice number to apply the credit to (if no invoice exists, we will coordinate to apply once first invoice posts).
3) Finance (Mina): prepare proforma credit memo for procurement; once PJ posts, create posted credit memo and corresponding journal entries.

I’ll schedule 15 min to walk through GLA mapping if helpful.

Marcus Lin
Senior Accounting Manager, Revenue
Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SummitAI credit request — approval and next steps

Thanks Marcus — I approve the $25k promo credit as contra-revenue (GLA 7200-PROMO).

Connor — please confirm: 1) final approval form completed (Marissa), 2) SummitAI procurement needs a proforma credit memo and PO will reference the proforma, and 3) the credit is to be applied to the first commercial invoice once issued. Once Marissa uploads the signed promo_approval_form.pdf I will countersign and instruct Finance Ops to create the proforma credit memo for DocuSign and transmittal.

Lauren — please notify Revenue Ops to expect a posted credit memo after invoice issuance so we can keep the revenuerecognition artifacts intact.

Connor: looping Priyanka and David to confirm the PO contact. Once we have the signed approval and the proforma credit memo, we’ll send the DocuSign link for SummitAI to countersign.

-Neha
VP, Finance (Revenue)
Redwood Inference
